items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: I played Tom Anderson on Ramport. When I was at the 10, I was just 19 years old.

ctx.x: But you said you worked in the district yourself. You must have been working out.
No, I didn't work in the district. I played Tom Anderson on Ramport. When I was at the 10, I was just 19 years old.
Did you play any guitar or banjo at that time? No. Never had a lesson on anything?
